top.summary: Smart metering in Latin America and the Caribbean is experiencing significant growth, with the installed base of smart electricity meters forecast to increase from 17.3 million units in 2024 to 61.3 million units by 2030, representing a 23.5% compound annual growth rate. Key drivers include grid modernization efforts, electricity theft reduction, and supportive government policies. Major utilities like Cemig, COPEL, Enel, and CPFL are expanding investments in advanced metering infrastructure.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: HSBC is winding down its transaction services business in Germany, eliminating approximately 320 positions by 2028 as part of its broader simplification program. The bank targets $2 billion in annualized savings by end-2026 and is redirecting resources toward higher-growth markets, particularly in Asia. top.title: Can Greece Add Another Growth Lever for JPMorgan in Europe?

The expansion aims to deepen client relationships and cross-sell treasury, payments, and investment banking services. While Greece alone won't materially impact near-term results, the strategic move supports long-term loan growth, advisory fees, and capital-markets revenues.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-0.6 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-0.6 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+0.8 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+0.8 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+0.7 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+0.7 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Can Ciena Sustain Its Strong Growth Amid Rising Optical Demand?
top.summary: Ciena Corporation reported record fiscal Q3 revenue of $1.67B (up 37% YoY) with adjusted EPS surging 215% to $2.11, driven by strong optical networks demand from AI infrastructure investments. The company projects fiscal 2027 revenue growth of at least 30% to $8.3-8.4B, though supply constraints remain a limiting factor. Competitors Corning and Viavi Solutions also benefit from AI infrastructure and optical connectivity tailwinds.

top.title: Celestica vs. Corning: Which AI Infrastructure Stock is a Better Buy?
top.summary: Both Celestica and Corning are positioned to benefit from the expanding AI infrastructure market, but Celestica emerges as the better investment option. Celestica shows stronger growth prospects with 64.27% projected sales growth and 87.11% EPS growth for 2026, driven by robust demand for 800G and 1.6T Ethernet switches, AI compute solutions, and partnerships with OpenAI and AMD. Corning, while benefiting from optical connectivity demand, faces headwinds from competition, consumer electronics weakness, and solar business execution risks. Celestica trades at a more attractive valuation (P/E of 20.04 vs. 42.46) and holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

top.title: Why Is Lumentum (LITE) Up 6.1% Since Last Earnings Report?
top.summary: Lumentum (LITE) reported Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings of $3.23 per share, up 267% YoY and beating estimates by 8.03%, with revenues surging 109.3% to $1.01 billion. Strong demand for cloud and AI products, particularly 1.6T transceivers and optical components, drove growth. The company posted record gross margins of 50.4% and operating margins of 36.6%, with guidance for Q1'27 revenues between $1.225-$1.275 billion. Lumentum has a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating with upward estimate revisions.

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

North America leads the market, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth.

top.title: Stock Market News for Sep 11, 2026
top.summary: U.S. stock markets declined on Thursday as surging oil prices and inflation data drove investor concerns about potential Fed rate hikes. Brent crude jumped 6.34% to $107.63 and WTI rose 6.69% to $102.48, both exceeding $100 for the first time since May. Rising Treasury yields and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East further pressured equities, with the Dow, Nasdaq, and S&P 500 all closing in the red. Markets are now pricing in a 70% probability of a Fed rate increase at next week's policy meeting.

top.title: Smart Metering in Latin America and the Caribbean - 3rd Edition Market Analysis and Forecasts to 2030
top.summary: Smart metering in Latin America and the Caribbean is experiencing significant growth, with the installed base of smart electricity meters forecast to increase from 17.3 million units in 2024 to 61.3 million units by 2030, representing a 23.5% compound annual growth rate. Brazil and Mexico are leading the market, accounting for over 65% of annual meter demand. Key drivers include grid modernization efforts, electricity theft reduction, and supportive government policies. Major utilities like Cemig, COPEL, Enel, and CPFL are expanding investments in advanced metering infrastructure.

top.title: IonQ Advances Quantum Computing With Superion 256: What's Ahead?
top.summary: IonQ has launched Superion 256, its sixth-generation quantum computing platform featuring integrated electronic qubit control and 256 qubits. The company achieved significant manufacturing improvements with SkyWater, reducing design cycles from 9 to 2 months and increasing wafer lot production 12-fold. The system is designed for data center deployment and scales to millions of qubits, with customer deliveries expected in 2027.

top.title: Quantum Up 322% in the Past 6 Months: Time to Buy, Hold or Sell?
top.summary: Quantum Corporation (QMCO) shares have surged 322.3% in six months, driven by strong enterprise demand for ActiveScale and tape storage solutions. The company reported 25.7% revenue growth to $80.8 million in fiscal Q1, with expanding tape adoption and improving margins. However, supply constraints, particularly for tape drives, limit near-term revenue conversion, with Q2 guidance at approximately $82 million.

top.title: Sports Event City, Connecting the World: Beijing Accelerates Building a World-Class Sports Host City
top.summary: Beijing held the 2026 CIFTIS Sports Services Section Main Forum on September 10, bringing together government officials, international sports organization leaders, and diplomats to discuss sports events as catalysts for urban development. As the world's first 'Dual Olympic City,' Beijing announced 11 major international sports events for autumn and winter, including the FIS Snowboard and Freestyle Ski Big Air World Cup, GT World Challenge Asia, and Intel Extreme Masters Beijing 2026. Participants emphasized that successful sports event cities integrate events into urban development strategies and residents' daily lives rather than simply pursuing event volume.

top.title: Atsign and Intel® solve the Edge AI encryption conundrum
top.summary: Atsign and Intel announced a collaboration that delivers approximately 88x performance improvement for hardware-accelerated, end-to-end encrypted Agent-to-Agent communications in autonomous edge AI systems. The partnership combines Atsign's trusted identity management with Intel's hardware security capabilities to enable secure, high-performance smart transportation infrastructure. Atsign has also been added to Intel's Industrial Builders partner program.

top.title: ASML Expands High-NA Ties With Samsung and Intel as AI Demand Builds
top.summary: ASML is expanding High-NA EUV lithography collaborations with Samsung and Intel to meet growing AI-driven chip manufacturing demands. Intel has already moved High-NA into production for Panther Lake and qualified it for 18A layers, while Samsung plans to introduce the technology into DRAM high-volume manufacturing by 2028. However, broader adoption remains uncertain as commercialization depends on individual customer qualification and manufacturing decisions.

top.title: HPE Surges 26% in 3 Months: Is it the Right Time to Buy the Stock?
top.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has outperformed its industry with a 25.9% gain over three months, driven by strong AI infrastructure demand. The company reported $2.4 billion in AI Systems orders and a record $7.6 billion total AI backlog in Q3 fiscal 2026. Cloud & AI revenues rose 25% with server revenues jumping 35%, while gross margins expanded to 40.4% and operating profit grew 155%. Despite the stock appreciation, HPE trades at a discount with a forward P/S ratio of 1.5 versus the industry average of 4.81, prompting analysts to recommend accumulation.

top.title: GSK's Specialty Medicines Drive Growth Amid Looming HIV Patent Cliff

However, GSK faces a significant challenge as dolutegravir patents expire in 2028-2029, threatening its HIV franchise which generated £2.74 billion in H1 2026. GSK is relying on long-acting HIV injectables and next-generation pipeline products to offset future generic competition.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: X Pay is live on mainnet
top.summary: X Pay has launched a payment gateway that enables any API or software to charge for individual HTTP requests and settle in USDC on Base mainnet. The service eliminates traditional payment barriers like accounts, API keys, and subscriptions by leveraging the x402 standard and stablecoins, allowing economically viable micropayments for the first time. The x402 standard, contributed by Coinbase and managed by the Linux Foundation, has already processed over 169 million payments across 590,000 buyers and 100,000 sellers.

top.title: On Holding (ONON) Down 13.5% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
top.summary: On Holding's stock has declined 13.5% since its Q2 2026 earnings report, underperforming the S&P 500. While the company reported earnings meeting consensus estimates with strong DTC growth (26% YoY), Asia-Pacific momentum, and improved profitability despite tariffs, revenue missed expectations at $1,076M vs. $1,114M consensus. Management raised 2026 gross margin guidance to at least 65% and maintained EBITDA margin guidance of 19.5-20%, expecting low-20% constant-currency sales growth for the year. However, analyst estimates have shifted downward by 10.1% in the past month, leading to a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating.

top.summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico (GAP) has secured Ps. 8,000 million in credit facilities from major banks including Santander, BBVA, HSBC, J.P. Morgan, and Scotiabank. top.summary: GSK's Specialty Medicines segment, accounting for over 40% of sales, grew 14% in H1 2026 driven by HIV, respiratory, and oncology products. gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.9 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -8.8 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -8.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
